resources.string: Size of the shanty box beside the chart
Wee shanty box over the whole chart
With the shanty box beside the chart closed, a wee shanty box bobs over the chart. Hold it, then drag it to move it.
No stowaways. To stow an app away, hold it in the fleet and choose Stow away from the fleet.

Through myCar sends the phone\'s sound over myCar\'s own link, the cable or Wi-Fi, as Android Auto does. Android asks to share your screen each drive, and a few apps block it. Bluetooth plays as the phone normally would, and Android never asks, but some cars only take calls over it. Automatic uses Bluetooth when the car takes the phone\'s shanties that way, and myCar\'s link when it doesn\'t.

Raise a flag when location is off
myCar calls out each turn through the ship\'s speakers, and the shanties dip while it speaks. Turn it off if your chart app\'s own voice already plays aboard.

Adds a Vehicle data tile: a live, raw dump of the head unit\'s sensor channel. Field labels (speed, RPM, fuel...) are salvaged from other reverse-engineering projects and unverified against this ship - treat them as a guess, not a fact, until you\'ve watched one change for yourself.
Show the list of changes once, the first time the ship connects after a refit.
